instruction: Candid fitness photograph, full shot, high-angle diagonal view of an indoor gym with wooden stairs in the background. In the background, the woman in the black crop top (R1) is in a pike position with her hands on the floor, looking down. In the foreground, the woman in the blue tank top (R2) is in a plank position with her right hand on a red medicine ball, looking down. The two women are positioned diagonally on the wooden and rubber floor mats under bright overhead gym lighting.
elements: R1 is in a pike position with her hands on the floor while R2 is not
R2 is in a plank position with her right hand on a red medicine ball while R1 is not
R1 looks down from a pike pose and R2 looks down from a plank pose
red medicine ball under R2's right hand
indoor gym with wooden stairs in the background
wooden and rubber floor mats under bright overhead gym lighting
